instruction.text: Jaz has 10 pencils. She has twice as many pencils as Robert. Make an equation to describe this. The unknown amount of Robert’s pencils can be written as 𝘳.
instruction.sound: ssml: Jaz has 10 pencils. She has twice as many pencils as Robert. Make an equation to describe this. The unknown amount of Robert’s pencils can be written as R.

instruction.text: Using your formula, work out how many pencils Robert has.

A taxi journey takes half as long as a bus journey to the same place. The bus takes 40 minutes. Make an equation to describe how long the taxi journey takes. The unknown value of the taxi journey can be written as 𝘵.
instruction.sound: ssml: A taxi journey takes half as long as a bus journey to the same place. The bus takes 40 minutes. Make an equation to describe how long the taxi journey takes. The unknown value of the taxi journey can be written as T.

instruction.text: Using your formula, work out how long the taxi journey takes.
Hayden says if he subtracts 5 from his age he gets the answer 5. Make an equation to describe what Hayden said. The unknown value of Hayden’s age can be written as 𝘩.
instruction.sound: ssml:Hayden says if he subtracts 5 from his age he gets the answer 5. Make an equation to describe Hayden’s age. The unknown value of Hayden’s age can be written as H.

instruction.text: Using the formula, work out how old Hayden is.

Agatha and Beatrice work in a cafe together. They earn the same amount, but Agatha spends £5 on lunch. Agatha ends the day with £85. Make an equation to describe Beatrice’s daily wage. The unknown value of Beatrice’s wage can be written as 𝘣.
instruction.sound: Agatha and Beatrice work in a cafe together. They earn the same amount, but Agatha spends £5 on lunch. Agatha ends the day with £85. Make an equation to describe Beatrice’s daily wage. The unknown value of Beatrice’s wage can be written as B.

instruction.text: Using your formula, work out how much Beatrice earns in a day.
